source: 帖子内容与表达_双轴分类手册_v2.md
sample_id: Blind unique id; no author or original id

content_labels.C_LIFE: 具体生活、关系与社会文化话题
content_labels.C_TOOLS: 工具、服务与记录奖励机制

expression_labels.F_GUIDANCE: 信息解释或可执行建议
expression_labels.F_INVITE_ASK: 联络邀请或向他人征询

record_fields.uncertain_content: array of content codes whose evidence is inconclusive
record_fields.uncertain_expression: array of expression codes whose evidence is inconclusive
record_fields.evidence: object mapping each positive code to one exact substring of text
record_fields.other_note: string describing C_OTHER or F_OTHER; empty otherwise

validation_rules: positive and uncertain codes disjoint per axis
readable required for any positive label
domain_state unspecified requires no content labels and no domain uncertainties
domain_state uncertain requires >=1 uncertain_content; other labels may be positive
domain_state unavailable requires insufficient observation, no content labels
evidence required for every positive label and must be exact non-empty substring of original text
C_OTHER or F_OTHER requires nonempty other_note
raw empty and cleaned empty are separate exclusion statuses outside this JSONL
blank negative is not unknown; absence can be considered zero only after complete readable examination of label in applicable domain
